neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak, suyun ya da içeceğin yeterli ve doyurucu niteliğidir; komşu ise içenin susuzluktan kurtulması sonucunu ve bunun mecazlı uzantısını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal suyu ve içeceği, doyurucu niteliğin taşıyıcısı olarak adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal susuzluğu giderme eylemini ve haber ya da görüşle iç rahatlığı bulma uzantısını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da su içmenin susuzluğu giderip rahatlık sağlaması alanında örtüşür.

branches.source_phrase_ar: يقال للماء نفس ولأن قوام النفس به (maqayis); النفس الماء وشراب ذو نفس أي فيه سعة وري وشراب غير ذي نفس (tahdhib)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar suyu yaşamın dayanağı sayar; içecekte bolluk ve susuzluğu giderme niteliğini olumlu ve olumsuz kalıplarla karşılaştırır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تسمية الماء نفسا، والشراب ذو النفس إذا كان فيه سعة وري، ونقيضه الشراب غير ذي نفس.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو النفس الروح نفسها ولا جرعة الشرب المعدودة فقط.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnızca verilen yay, sabah, gündüz ve su kalıplarının ortak görüntüsünü topluca anlatmak için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yarılma, açılma, uzama ve yayılma yönlerini kalıp sınırıyla birlikte korur.

concept_gloss.text: kalıba bağlı yarılıp açılma ve genişleme

concept_map.definition: Yalnızca belirli kalıplarda, yayın yarılması; sabahın açılması; gündüzün uzayıp genişlemesi veya ırmak suyunun artıp yayılmasıdır. Ortak görüntü, kapalı ya da dar bir durumdan açılma ve genişlemeye geçiştir.

facets.statement: Yay için kullanıldığında yarılma ya da çatlama olayını bildirir.
Sabah ve gündüz için kullanıldığında aydınlığın açılmasını, sürenin uzayıp genişlemesini bildirir.
Irmak ya da dalga için kullanıldığında suyun artıp dışarı doğru yayılmasını bildirir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Karanlığın yarılıp sabah aydınlığının belirmesi kalıbında doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Sabah aydınlığının yarılıp açılarak belirmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Irmak suyunun yükselip çevreye doğru yayılması kalıbında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Su miktarındaki artışı ve dışa doğru yayılmayı korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yayılma ve açılmayı belirli öznelere bağlayan kalıplardan oluşur; genel bir çıplak anlam ya da canlı solunumu değildir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesindeki kullanımlar, belirli öznelerin yarılması, açılması, uzayıp genişlemesi veya suyu artarak yayılması ortak görüntüsünde birleşir. Bu anlam yalnızca verilen kalıplarda geçerlidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca yay, sabah, gündüz ve ırmakla kurulan kalıplara bağlıdır; çıplak kök anlamına genellenmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; sabahın açılması ortaklığını ve kalıpların farklı yönlere uzanmasını en açık gösteren komşu seçildi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ortak sabah görüntüsüne rağmen odak dalın öteki kalıpları yay, gündüz ve suya uzanır; komşu ise bulut açıklığı ve yağış alanındaki boşluk yönünde genişler.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, sabah yanında yayın çatlamasını, gündüzün genişlemesini ve suyun artmasını da kapsayan ayrı kalıplar taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, güneş ya da ayın bulut aralığından çıkmasını ve çevresi yağmurluyken kuru kalan yeri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal, sabah aydınlığının karanlığı yararak ortaya çıkması görüntüsünde kesişir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: تنفست القوس انشقت (maqayis); تنفس الصبح أي تبلج وتنفس النهار إذا زاد والموج إذا نضح الماء (sihah); إذا انشق الفجر وانفلق وتنفس دجلة إذا زاد ماؤها (tahdhib); تنفس النهار عبارة عن توسعه (mufradat)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak kaydı, yaydaki çatlama, sabahtaki açılma, gündüzdeki genişleme ve sudaki artışı kalıba bağlı bir açılma-yayılma görüntüsünde birleştirir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تنفس الصبح والنهار إذا تبلج أو امتد، وتنفس القوس إذا انشقت، وزيادة الماء أو الموج حين يخرجان أو ينتشران.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو التنفس الحيواني ولا مجرد السعة الزمنية إلا إذا كان اللفظ عن الانفتاح أو الامتداد.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyin yüksek değeri insanların onu istemesine ve elde etmek için yarışmasına yol açtığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yüksek değeri, güçlü isteği ve uğrunda yarışılmayı birlikte korur.

concept_map.definition: İnsanların değer ve önem yüklediği, elde etmek ya da benzemek için uğrunda yarıştığı şeydir; bu yönelim, şeyin başkasına geçmesini istemeyerek esirgeme veya kıskanma biçimini de alabilir.

facets.statement: Yüksek değer ve önem taşıdığı için insanların arzuladığı şeydir.
İnsanlar bu şeyi elde etmek ya da üstünlere benzemek için birbirleriyle yarışabilir.
Değerli şeyi başkasından esirgeme veya ona sahip olanı kıskanma biçiminde bir sahiplenme doğabilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Değerli görülen şeyin başkasına geçmesi istenmediğinde veya sahibi kıskanıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Değerli şeye yönelik kıskanç sahiplenmeyi ve esirgemeyi korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal dışarıdaki değerli şeye yönelen istek ve çekişmeyle ilgilidir; kişinin kendi onuru ya da yücelik duygusu değildir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi değerli şeyi, ona yönelen isteği, uğrunda yarışmayı ve başkasına geçmesini istemeyerek esirgeme ya da kıskanmayı tek bir değer-yönelim zincirinde açıkça birleştirir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir şeyi elde etme ya da üstünlere benzeme yarışı
sahip olduğu şey yüzünden onu kıskanmak

lexicalization_scope.note: Biçimler değerli şeyi ve yarışmayı, kalıplar ise o şeyi başkasından esirgeme veya kıskanmayı anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; değerli nesne ortaklığı yanında yarışma sınırını görünür kılan en yararlı komşu yayımlandı.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal değerden doğan kişiler arası yarışma ve kıskançlığı kurar; komşu dal ise değerli nesne ile sahibinin ona bağlılığı üzerinde durur.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, yüksek değerin yanında o şey uğrundaki yarışmayı ve kıskanç esirgemeyi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, sahibinin bağlandığı ve koruduğu malı ya da başka değerli nesneleri adlandırmaya ağırlık verir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da değerli görülen ve sahibinin kolayca vazgeçmediği şeyi kapsar.

branches.source_phrase_ar: شيء نفيس ذو نفس وخطر يتنافس به والتنافس يبرز كل واحد قوة نفسه (maqayis); شيء نفيس متنافس فيه ونفست به ضننت (ayn); نافست في الشيء إذا رغبت فيه وتنافسوا فيه ونفس به أي ضن أو حسد (sihah); مال نفيس ومنفس وكل شيء له خطر وقدر ونفس عليك أي حسدك (tahdhib); المنافسة مجاهدة النفس للتشبه بالأفاضل ونفست بكذا ضنت نفسي به وشيء نفيس (mufradat)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yüksek değer, ona duyulan istek, yarışma ve değerli şeyi başkasından esirgeme ya da kıskanma ilişkilerini tek bir toplu iddiada birleştirir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النفيس والنفاسة والمنفس، والرغبة والمنافسة في الشيء، والضن أو الحسد به إذا كان لقيمته ورغبة النفس فيه.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو عزة النفس والهمة في صاحبها إلا إذا كان الكلام عن المال أو الشيء المرغوب فيه.

concept_gloss.applicability: Canlılığı sağlayan ve bedenden ayrılması ölüm anlamına gelen yaşam taşıyıcısı için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bedeni, yaşam verme işlevini ve ayrılınca ölüm sonucunu korur.

concept_map.definition: Bedeni canlı tutan ve ayrılmasıyla ölümün gerçekleştiği candır. Bu yaşam taşıyıcısı bakımından her insan ayrı bir canlı birey olarak da sayılabilir.

facets.statement: Bedene yaşam veren ve bedenden ayrılması ölüm sayılan candır.
Bu canı taşıyan her insan ayrı bir canlı birey olarak adlandırılabilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsanların tek tek canlı varlıklar olarak sayıldığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Her insanın ayrı bir canlı birey olarak sayılmasını korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bedensel yaşamı sağlayan can ve canlı bireydir; düşünce, özdeşlik vurgusu, kan ya da soluk değildir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bedeni canlı tutan ilkeyi, onun bedenden çıkmasıyla ölümü ve her insanın canlı bir birey olarak bu adla sayılabilmesini doğrudan açıklar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal, bedene yaşam veren canı ve bununla canlı sayılan bireyi kapsar; kalıp anlamı içe aktarılmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar gözden geçirildi; yalnızca yaşam veren can anlamında tam sınır eşleşmesi gösteren eş anlamlı komşu yayımlandı.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Verilen kartlarda çekirdek, yaşam işlevi ve bedenden ayrılma sınırı bütünüyle örtüşür; anlamlı bir ayrım yoktur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bedeni canlı tutan canı ve onun bedenden çıkmasını aynı sınırlarla anlatır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: النفس الروح الذي به حياة الجسد وكل إنسان نفس (ayn); النفس الروح يقال خرجت نفسه (sihah); خرجت نفس فلان أي روحه ونفس الحياة هي الروح (tahdhib); النفس الروح في قوله أخرجوا أنفسكم (mufradat)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bedensel yaşamı sağlayan can, bu canın çıkmasıyla ölüm ve insanın canlı birey olarak sayılması üzerinde birleşir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النفس بمعنى الروح والحياة، وكل إنسان نفس، وخروج النفس عند الموت، والنفس الحية التي بها حياة الجسد.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو ذات الشيء للتوكيد ولا ما في النفس من قصد أو غيب فقط.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesne ya da kişinin başkası değil tam olarak kendisi olduğu vurgulandığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Özdeşliği, bütünlüğü, gerçekliği ve pekiştirme işlevini korur.

concept_gloss.text: şeyin kendisi ve bütün öz varlığı

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başkası ya da bir parçası değil, bütün gerçeği ve öz varlığıyla kendisi olduğunu vurgulamaktır. Kişi için kullanıldığında onun aracısız biçimde bizzat bulunmasını bildirir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin bütün gerçeği ve öz varlığıyla kendisini pekiştirerek gösterir.
Kişinin başkası aracılığıyla değil, bizzat kendisinin bulunmasını belirtir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin aracı kullanmadan doğrudan bulunduğu ya da eylemi yaptığı bağlamda doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin doğrudan ve aracısız bulunması vurgusunu korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca özdeşlik ve pekiştirme kalıplarındadır; canlılık ilkesi, zararlı bakış ya da iç düşünce değildir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin aynısını, bütün varlığını, gerçeğini ve özünü vurgulayan kullanımı açıkça verir. Kişinin aracısız olarak bizzat bulunması da aynı özdeşlik kalıbına bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam, bir şeyin kendisini ya da bir kişinin bizzat bulunmasını bildiren kalıplarla sınırlıdır; çıplak anlama genellenmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday kartlar karşılaştırıldı; özdeşlik ortaklığını ve pekiştirme-seçip belirleme farkını gösteren komşu seçildi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kalıba bağlı özdeşlik pekiştirmesidir; komşu dal özdeşliğe ek olarak bir öğeyi topluluktan ayırıp belirleme işlevi taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, bütün öz varlığı ve bizzat bulunmayı pekiştiren kalıpları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, bir öğeyi topluluğun geri kalanından özellikle seçip belirtme kullanımını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyin başka bir şey değil, tam olarak kendisi olduğunu bildirir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: كل شيء بعينه نفس (ayn); نفس الشيء عينه يؤكد به (sihah); معنى النفس حقيقة الشيء وجملته وذاته كلها وعين الشيء وكنهه وجوهره (tahdhib); نفسه ذاته (mufradat)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, şeyin kendisini bütün gerçeği ve özüyle vurgulama ile kişinin bizzat bulunması kullanımında birleşir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النفس بمعنى عين الشيء، ذاته، حقيقته، جملته، كنهه وجوهره، واستعمالها للتوكيد.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو الروح الحية ولا العين المؤذية ولا المعنى الباطن من القصد إلا بقرينة.

branches.branch_image_ar: ما في النفس من عقل وروع

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişinin dışa vurmadığı içeriği veya ayrım yapmasını sağlayan zihinsel yetisi anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İç düşünceyi, niyeti, bilgiyi ve ayırt etme yetisini birlikte korur.

concept_gloss.text: iç düşünce, niyet ve ayırt etme gücü

concept_map.definition: Kişinin içinde bulunan, henüz dışa vurulmamış düşünce, niyet veya bilgidir. Aynı alan, kişinin ayırt etmesini sağlayan zihinsel gücü de kapsar.

facets.statement: Kişinin içinde tuttuğu düşünce, niyet ya da kendine özgü bilgidir.
Doğru ayrımlar yapmayı sağlayan zihinsel yeti de bu içsel idrak alanında adlandırılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin henüz söylemediği bir şeyi düşünmesi ya da yapmaya niyetlenmesi bağlamında doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Düşüncenin içte bulunmasını ve henüz dışa vurulmamasını korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal iç düşünce ve ayırt etme gücüyle sınırlıdır; kişinin bütünü, bedensel canı veya yalnızca dışa vurulmuş söz değildir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişinin içinde taşıdığı düşünceyi, niyeti ve bilgiyi; ayrıca ayırt etmeyi sağlayan zihinsel yetiyi açıkça aynı içsel idrak alanında toplar.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: onun içinden geçen düşünce ya da niyet

lexicalization_scope.note: Kalıp kullanım içteki düşünce ve niyeti, ayrı birim ise ayırt etmeyi sağlayan zihinsel gücü anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; söylenmemiş düşünce komşusu, içsel alanın söz tasarısından daha geniş olduğunu en açık biçimde gösterir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal içsel idrakin daha geniş alanıdır; komşu dal özellikle dile getirilmeden önce zihinde tasarlanan söze yönelir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, dışa vurulmamış düşüncenin yanında niyet, iç bilgi ve ayırt etme yetisini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, sözle ortaya konmadan önce zihinde tasarlanan söyleyiş içeriğine odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişinin zihninde bulunan fakat henüz sözle açıklanmamış içeriği kapsar.

branches.source_phrase_ar: نفس العقل التي يكون بها التمييز وفي نفس فلان أن يفعل أي في روعه وتعلم ما في نفسي أي ما عندي أو غيبك (tahdhib); يعلم ما في أنفسكم وتعلم ما في نفسي ولا أعلم ما في نفسك (mufradat)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, kişinin içindeki düşünce ve bilgiyi ayırt etme yetisiyle birlikte içsel idrak alanında birleştirir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ما في نفس المرء من روع وقصد، ونفس العقل والتمييز، وما يعبر عنه بالغيب أو العندية في سياق ما في النفس.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو الذات المؤكدة ولا الروح التي بها الحياة إلا إذا دل السياق على الإدراك الباطن.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişinin dayanıklılığı, cömertliği ve kendine verdiği yüksek değer birlikte anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Karakter gücünü, cömertliği, onuru ve yüksek özdeğeri birlikte korur.

concept_map.definition: Kişide görülen sağlam karakter, dayanıklılık ve cömertliktir; buna bağlı ikinci görünüm, kişinin kendi değerini yüksek tutması, onur, yüksek amaç ve kimi bağlamlarda gurur göstermesidir.

facets.statement: Kişinin sağlam karakterli, dayanıklı ve cömert oluşunu bildirir.
Kişinin büyüklük duygusu, gururu, onuru, yüksek amacı ve kendine saygısı da ayrı görünüm olarak aktarılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin kendi değerini koruması, yüksek hedef taşıması veya gurur göstermesi bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Onuru, yüksek amacı ve kendine değer verme yönünü korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Karakter gücü ile yüksek özdeğer aynı dalda iki bağlı görünüm olarak ayrılır; dışarıdaki değerli mal ve onun için yarışma kapsama girmez.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir yanda karakter, dayanıklılık ve cömertliği; öte yanda büyüklük duygusu, gurur, onur, yüksek amaç ve kendine saygıyı aktarır. Dal korunabilir, ancak bu iki görünüm tek ve ayrışmaz bir huy gibi sunulmamalıdır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: sağlam karakterli, dayanıklı ve cömert adam
büyüklük duygusu, onur, yüksek amaç ve kendine saygı

lexicalization_scope.note: Kişiyle kurulan kalıp karakter, dayanıklılık ve cömertliği; çıplak biçim büyüklük, onur ve yüksek amacı bildirir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday kartlar karşılaştırıldı; cömertlik ortaklığı ile karakter gücü ve eylem hevesi ayrımını gösteren komşu seçildi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak kişinin yerleşik karakter gücü ve özdeğerini anlatır; komşu ise iyilik yapma anındaki gönüllü canlılık ve atılganlığı öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, dayanıklılık ve cömertliğin yanında gurur, onur ve yüksek amacı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, iyilik yapmaya hevesle yönelme, canlılık ve gönül genişliği üzerinde durur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal, cömert ve iyi davranışa yatkın kişi görünümünde örtüşür.

branches.source_phrase_ar: رجل له نفس أي خلق وجلادة وسخاء (ayn); النفس العظمة والكبر والعزة والهمة والأنفة (tahdhib)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak kaydı, sağlam ve cömert karakter görünümünü kişinin büyüklük, onur, yüksek amaç ve kendine saygı duygularıyla yan yana getirir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النفس بمعنى الخلق والجلادة والسخاء، وبمعنى العظمة والكبر والعزة والهمة والأنفة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو النفيس من المال ولا المنافسة على شيء خارج النفس.

concept_gloss.applicability: Mekânsal aralık, nesne boyutu, ek süre veya bir işteki hareket alanı anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Mekânı, boyutu, süreyi ve hareket alanını ortak genişleme ölçüsüyle korur.

concept_map.definition: Yer bakımından uzaklık veya aralık, boyut bakımından uzunluk ve genişlik, zaman ya da iş bakımından ise ek süre ve hareket alanıdır. Bütün kullanımlarda sınırlar arasındaki payın büyümesi esastır.

facets.statement: Mekânda iki sınır arasındaki uzaklık, açıklık veya boyutsal genişliktir.
Zamanda ek süre, işte ise rahat davranmaya elveren hareket alanıdır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir işi yapmak için yeterli serbestlik ve ek zaman bulunduğu bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İşteki serbestliği ve ek süre payını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.text: rahat hareket edecek alan ve süre

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal ölçülebilir yer, boyut veya süre genişliğidir; belirli bir sıkıntıyı giderme ya da sabahın açılması değildir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi mekânsal uzaklık ve genişliği, işte hareket alanı ve süre payını, ayrıca uzunluk ve zaman uzatımını aynı genişleme ölçüsü altında açıkça toplar.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ek süre ya da hareket alanı
daha uzak, daha uzun ya da daha geniş

lexicalization_scope.note: Kalıp kullanım bir işteki hareket alanını, biçimler ise süre payı ile mekânsal ya da boyutsal genişliği anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; uzunluk ve uzaklık ortaklığının yanında odaktaki süre ve hareket alanı ekini gösteren komşu yayımlandı.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genişleyen payı yer, boyut ve süre arasında geneller; komşu dal belirli varlıkların uzun veya uzak oluşuna ve işin uzamasına yönelir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, uzaklık ve uzunluğun yanında ek süreyi ve bir işteki rahat hareket alanını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, uzun insanı, uçsuz bucaksız yeri ve uzun süren işleri özel kullanımlar olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal mekânsal uzaklık, uzunluk ve bir işin sürmesi alanında örtüşür.

branches.source_phrase_ar: هذا المكان أنفس من ذاك أي أبعد شيئا (ayn); أنت في نفس من أمرك أي في سعة ولك في هذا الأمر نفسة أي مهلة (sihah); هذا المنزل أنفس أي أبعد وكتبت كتابا نفسا أي طويلا وزد في أجلي نفسا وبين الفريقين نفس أي متسع (tahdhib)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar uzaklık, açıklık, uzunluk, ek süre ve işte hareket alanını sınırlar arasındaki payın genişlemesi altında birleştirir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه السعة في الأمر، والفسحة، والمهلة، وطول الأجل أو النهار أو الكتاب، وبعد المنزل واتساع ما بين الفريقين.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو تفريج الكربة المخصوص ولا تنفس الصبح من حيث الانفلاق إلا إن كان المراد مطلق الامتداد.

concept_gloss.applicability: Belirli oyun okunun baskın aktarımdaki sırası ve pay değeri kastedildiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Oyun alanını, belirli oku, beşinci sırayı ve beş payı korur.

concept_gloss.text: eski bahis oyunundaki beşinci pay oku

concept_map.definition: Eski bir bahis oyununda kullanılan, çoğunluk aktarımına göre beşinci sıradaki ve beş pay taşıyan oktur. Başka bir aktarım onu dördüncü sıraya koyar.

facets.statement: Eski bahis oyunundaki beşinci pay oku olarak ve beş payla tanımlanır.
Aynı toplu kaynak kaydında okun dördüncü sırada olduğu yönünde karşı bir aktarım bulunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sıra konusundaki karşı aktarım özellikle belirtilirken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli oyun okunu ve dördüncü sıra karşı aktarımını korur.

contextual_glosses.text: dördüncü sayıldığı da aktarılan oyun oku

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Adlandırma eski bahis oyunundaki belirli oka aittir; temel sıra beşinci, kayıtlı karşı görüş dördüncüdür.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin baskın bildirimi, belirli bahis okunun beşinci sırada olduğu ve beş pay taşıdığı yönündedir. Aynı toplu iddiada dördüncü sıra biçiminde bir aktarım da bulunduğu için sıra tartışmasız gösterilemez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: eski bahis oyunundaki beşinci pay oku; bir aktarıma göre dördüncü ok

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçim yalnızca eski bahis oyunundaki belirli pay okunu adlandırır; kişi ya da değer yarışması anlamı taşımaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday kartlar değerlendirildi; genel oyun oku komşusu, özel sıra ve pay değerinin dalı nasıl daralttığını en açık biçimde gösterir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal sıra ve pay değeriyle belirlenen özel oktur; komşu dal ise herhangi bir oyun okunu veya işlenmemiş ok gövdesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, belirli sıraya ve beş pay değerine sahip tek bir oyun okunu adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: oyun oku ve çıplak ok gövdesi
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, henüz uç ve tüy takılmamış ok gövdesini ve oyun oklarının herhangi birini genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da eski bahis oyununda kullanılan ok biçimli araç alanında kesişir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: النافس الخامس من القداح (ayn); النافس الخامس من سهام الميسر ويقال هو الرابع (sihah); النافس الخامس من قداح الميسر وفيه خمسة فروض (tahdhib)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak kaydı belirli oyun okunu çoğunlukla beşinci sıra ve beş payla tanımlar; bunun yanında dördüncü sıra aktarımını da korur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النافس اسما لقدح من قداح الميسر، خاصة الخامس على نص أكثر المصادر، مع التنبيه إلى قول الرابع في Sihah.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو العائن ولا المتنافس في القيمة.

root_profile.summary: Kök, soluk alıp vermeden sıkıntı giderme, kan, doğum, içim payı, su, açılma-genişleme, değer yarışı, canlılık, özdeşlik, iç düşünce, karakter ve eski oyun okuna uzanan çok dallı bir anlam ağı kurar. Dalların bir bölümü soluk ve yaşam çevresinde gevşekçe bağlanırken bir bölümü kalıba bağlı uzmanlaşmış adlandırmalardır.

text.arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ

baseline.text: Andolsun, Lokman'a, “Allah'a şükret” diye hikmet verdik. Kim şükrederse ancak kendisi için şükreder; kim nankörlük ederse Allah hiçbir şeye muhtaç değildir ve övgüye layıktır.

findings.text: Hikmetin ilk işi şükür olarak belirince hikmet, alınan nimeti kendine mal etmeyi engelleyen düzeltici bir tanıma ve kendini sınırlama yetisi olur.
Şükür, az bir imkânın etkisini alıcının kendi benliğinde büyütüp görünür kılan besleyici bir çoğalma gibi işler.

activation_trace.role: Giving and delivery supply the incoming endowment that gratitude works upon.
A little input producing a visible effect models gratitude as recipient-side amplification.
Fullness and abundant yield supply the realized increase within the grateful recipient.
The thing's own self and essence locate the resulting change in the grateful actor.
Freedom from need removes God from the beneficiary side of the exchange.

changed_reading.after: Gratitude realizes received provision as sufficiency and abundance in the grateful self; the giver gains nothing.
changed_reading.before: Gratitude repays the giver for a benefit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence gives wisdom, commands gratitude, locates its yield in the grateful self, and closes with divine independence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The gift is incoming provision; the small-input/visible-effect and fullness images make gratitude the recipient's capacity to realize and enlarge what was received. The self is where that yield accrues, while divine independence blocks any idea that God needs repayment.

activation_trace.role: Prevention and repulse for reform make wisdom a check against damaging response.
A bridle restrains an animal's motion and models wisdom as embodied self-regulation.
Recognition and display of favor supply the outwardly governed response.
Covering a favor supplies the opposed failure to let the gift remain acknowledged.

changed_reading.after: Wisdom is a bridle-like capacity that reforms conduct by keeping received good from being covered and directing it into gratitude.
changed_reading.before: Wisdom is primarily possession of correct propositions.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Wisdom is given immediately before the command to be grateful and the polarity between gratitude and covering.
baseline_models.mechanism: The prevention-for-reform and bridle images make wisdom an operative restraint that checks corrupt motion. It governs whether a received good is acknowledged and displayed as gratitude or covered as ingratitude, so its benefit is the recipient's re-formation rather than stored information.

activation_trace.role: A managed watercourse supplies the channel through which the bestowed wisdom can become effective.
Greening after minimal rain supplies the first visible response to received provision.
Fresh shoots emerging from plant or tree make gratitude the manifestation of latent growth.
Covering seed with soil supplies the buried state that can either remain concealed or issue in growth.
Water that sustains life makes the self the living site served by the routed provision.

changed_reading.after: Wisdom is routed provision, and gratitude is the recipient's emergence from latent gift into visible, self-sustaining growth.
changed_reading.before: The gift of wisdom is a possession and gratitude is a verbal response to it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The roots for giving, gratitude, self, and covering form a material sequence around the bestowed wisdom.
baseline_models.mechanism: A watercourse routes incoming provision; slight moisture becomes visible greenness and fresh shoots, while seed-covering supplies the ambiguous buried stage. This makes wisdom a channel and gratitude the emergence of latent yield for the self, with ingratitude figured as arrested concealment rather than lack of an initial gift.

activation_trace.role: Recognition of favor supplies the recipient's truthful acknowledgment.
Independence from need excludes praise as a resource God lacks.
Sufficing and benefiting another place efficacy on the giver-to-recipient side.
Finding something commendable after experience makes praise recognition rather than manufacture.
Many praiseworthy qualities supply stable worth independent of the recipient's response.

changed_reading.after: God's praiseworthiness is discovered and attested, not created; gratitude changes the recognizer while the praised source remains sufficient.
changed_reading.before: Thanksgiving contributes praise or value back to God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The grateful person's gain is restricted to the self, while God is simultaneously independent and praiseworthy.
baseline_models.mechanism: Gratitude recognizes a favor; praise finds its object already commendable after encounter and testing. Divine self-sufficiency and sufficing power make praise an attestation by the changed recipient, not value produced for or supplied to God.

activation_trace.role: Minimal provision showing a visible effect is the focus-side amplification anchor.
Sending something down and delivering it supplies the incoming stage of the material sequence.
Conveying water by irrigation supplies the medium that carries provision to its recipient.
Plant emerging from earth supplies the visible yield that gratitude analogically produces.

changed_reading.after: The surrounding ecology activates gratitude as the visible germination of bestowed wisdom within its recipient.
changed_reading.before: The growth language in gratitude's inventory is a remote lexical curiosity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context supplies a literal descent-water-germination chain. It activates the focus inventory's otherwise distant small-input and shoot images, making bestowed wisdom an input whose grateful reception becomes observable growth in the recipient.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ecological sequence and the focus supplies small-input growth; I infer that the sequence analogizes received wisdom becoming grateful yield. Alternatively, 31:10 may remain only a creation sign with no inward mechanism.
structural_cues: 31:10 orders descent, water, and germination as a material sequence before the focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: Preventive restraint for reform anchors wisdom as selective boundary-making.
Recognition of favor directly extends the gratitude command toward both God and parents.
Hidden bodily carrying supplies the material dependence that gratitude must remember.
Repeated loss of strength supplies the cost borne by the parent.
Weaning and separation mark dependence becoming distinction rather than erased relation.
Continuing companionship supplies care after obedience has been limited.
Recognizably good conduct supplies the quality governing that continued companionship.

changed_reading.after: Gratitude forms a self capable of remembering dependence while holding a principled boundary and preserving good relation.
changed_reading.before: Being grateful for oneself sounds like isolated inward gain.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gratitude is extended to parents through bodily carrying, repeated weakness, and weaning, but the next ayah refuses false obedience while preserving good companionship. Wisdom's restraint therefore becomes calibrated relational fidelity: acknowledge real dependence without surrendering judgment or severing care.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies embodied parental cost, gratitude, refused obedience, and retained companionship; I infer that Luqman's wisdom regulates competing obligations. Alternatively, the parental instructions may be an inserted general rule rather than an enactment of the wisdom in 31:12.
structural_cues: 31:14 repeats the gratitude imperative with God and parents as objects; 31:15 juxtaposes negated obedience with commanded companionship.

activation_trace.role: A slight input with manifest effect anchors the no-minimum-threshold reading.
A seed capable of sprouting supplies minute but live potential.
Massive hard rock supplies maximal concealment and obstruction around the tiny potential.
Coming and arrival supply the eventual bring-forth that defeats concealment.
Smallness, precision, and hiddenness make fine-grained retrieval the operative scale.

changed_reading.after: Even minute gratitude can remain hidden yet still return to the self through eventual retrieval and consequence.
changed_reading.before: Gratitude benefits the self through an immediate felt or visible return.

context_deltas.mechanism: A tiny grain can be hidden inside hard enclosure yet be brought forth with exactness. Joined to gratitude's little-input effect, this makes the self-benefit neither necessarily immediate nor visible now: even a minute grateful response remains retrievable and consequential.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies minute hidden potential and eventual retrieval; I infer that this sharpens the focus claim about gratitude's return to the self. Alternatively, 31:16 may concern accountability generally, not the timing of gratitude's benefit.
structural_cues: 31:16 nests the grain across rock, heavens, and earth before the bring-forth clause.

activation_trace.role: The physical bridle supplies the focus-side instrument for governing motion.
Tilting cheek and neck away in pride supplies a misdirected bodily angle to correct.
Walking and movement provide the bodily channel in which regulation appears.
Moderation between extremes supplies the target setting for gait.
Holding back and lowering by reduction supplies calibrated vocal amplitude.
Audible sound supplies the concrete output governed by that reduction.

changed_reading.after: His wisdom is also an embodied regulator that tunes direction, pace, posture, and volume.
changed_reading.before: Luqman's wisdom is the abstract truth of his teaching.

context_deltas.mechanism: The bridle image becomes concrete in commands that regulate facial angle, gait, pace, and vocal amplitude. Luqman's bestowed wisdom is thus exhibited as fine motor and social calibration, not merely as the content of his sayings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a wisdom attribution and later bodily commands; I infer that the commands enact the earlier gift. Alternatively, they may be examples of counsel without defining wisdom's mechanism.
structural_cues: The attribution of wisdom is followed by Luqman's imperatives governing cheek, gait, and voice in 31:18-19.

activation_trace.role: Recognition and display of favor anchor the response to already present blessing.
Breadth and length sufficient to cover supply the surrounding extent of provision.
Good condition and blessing identify what surrounds and supports the recipient.
Grasping and retaining something supply the recipient's active attachment.
Firmness and secure construction supply the stability gained by holding.

changed_reading.after: Gratitude is a stabilizing hold by which the self remains attached to provision that already encompasses it.
changed_reading.before: Gratitude records a past benefit after receiving it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Complete, covering blessing is followed by the image of holding fast to something firm. This activates gratitude as self-stabilizing attachment within provision already surrounding the person, rather than as production of a benefit that was absent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enveloping blessing followed by grasp and firmness; I infer that gratitude is a way the self maintains attachment to given support. Alternatively, the grip may characterize submission and good action broadly rather than gratitude specifically.
structural_cues: 31:22 root ع ر و at word 10 has no branch inventory; its handle construction is used only as structural support beside the citable grasp and firmness roots.

activation_trace.role: Giving supplies the apparent transfer whose depletion model the context revises.
Repeated independence from need denies depletion or required return.
Stable abundance of praiseworthy qualities keeps worth independent of recipient response.
Vast abundant water supplies the imagined maximal material stock.
An inkwell extending a pen with ink turns the seas into a writing supply.
Exhaustion and cessation, explicitly negated, supply the non-depletion mechanism.
An intelligible word that expands into expression makes the source communicable without making it exhaustible.
Firmly perfected construction links the inexhaustible words back to the focus gift of wisdom.

changed_reading.after: The gift is a finite recipient's access to a non-depleting source, so gratitude marks reception rather than replenishment or payment.
changed_reading.before: Giving wisdom transfers a finite good for which gratitude is due in return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus closing pair recurs, then seas extending ink cannot exhaust divine words and wisdom closes the scene. Bestowed wisdom therefore reads as a communicable instantiation of a non-depleting source; gratitude acknowledges participation in it but neither replenishes nor compensates that source.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated independence, limitless words, and wisdom; I infer that Luqman's bestowed wisdom participates in a non-rival source. Alternatively, non-exhaustion may qualify divine words without describing the ontology of Luqman's gift.
structural_cues: The focus closing pair recurs at 31:26, and the next ayah combines non-exhaustion with a closing wisdom attribute.

activation_trace.role: A ship turning through water supplies the moving platform of reception.
Flowing movement supplies changing conditions rather than a static moment of gift.
Blessed good condition identifies the enabling provision carrying the vessel.
Holding the self back from panic supplies continuity under strain.
Sustained recognition of favor supplies the paired capacity to perceive signs in passage.

changed_reading.after: Gratitude is durable orientation across a changing passage, maintained together with restraint under strain.
changed_reading.before: Gratitude is a momentary acknowledgment immediately after a gift.

context_deltas.mechanism: A vessel moves through the sea by blessing so that signs become visible, and the receptive type combines intensive patience with intensive gratitude. Gratitude becomes a longitudinal capacity to keep reading gift as conditions move, with patience restraining the self from abandoning that recognition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vessel, flow, blessing, signs, and the patient-grateful pair; I infer a navigational model of durable reception. Alternatively, these may simply name observers suited to maritime signs, not redefine the focus gratitude.
structural_cues: 31:31 pairs intensive patient and grateful forms after a moving-vessel sign and a purpose of showing signs.

activation_trace.role: Recognition and display of favor anchor the durable response opposed to later concealment.
A cover settling over and hiding something supplies the external engulfment that provokes recognition.
The alternate mapped covering image preserves general concealment as a second activation, not a collapsed duplicate.
Rescue by separation supplies the sharp change of condition after danger.
Denial despite knowledge makes the later failure remembered rather than ignorant.
Betrayal and failure to keep faith supply the broken continuity across rescue.
Covering a favor names the post-rescue concealment of the benefit just experienced.

changed_reading.after: Ingratitude can be a post-rescue betrayal that re-covers known favor; gratitude is retained recognition across changed conditions.
changed_reading.before: Ingratitude is a static absence of recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Engulfing cover produces sincere recognition; rescue separates the people from danger, after which knowledgeable denial, betrayal, and ingratitude appear. Kufr in the focus is thereby temporalized as re-covering a known favor after conditions improve, while gratitude becomes fidelity to recognition across the transition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies before-and-after states, knowledgeable denial, betrayal, and ingratitude; I infer that continuity of recognition is the test. Alternatively, the people after rescue may divide into groups, so not every later ingrate need be the same person who voiced sincerity.
structural_cues: 31:32 uses a when/then-when reversal from engulfment and sincere appeal to rescue and differentiated aftermath.

activation_trace.role: Acknowledging favor anchors the act that is relational without becoming transferable.
The actor's own self and essence locate the nondelegable yield.
Standing in another's place supplies the substitution that both clauses explicitly deny.
The split root's cutting image supplies an exploratory severing of the imagined transfer channel.
Offspring in a line of descent supplies the close relation across which substitution still fails.
Parents defined through birth supply the reciprocal side of the mirrored relation.

changed_reading.after: Gratitude is relationally owed, yet the self it forms and the consequence it bears cannot be outsourced even to parent or child.
changed_reading.before: For oneself means private or self-interested gain detached from others.

context_deltas.mechanism: The parental gratitude of the earlier context is answered by a double denial that parent or child can stand in for the other. The grateful act remains relationally owed, but the formation and final consequence that return to the self cannot be delegated along even the closest line of descent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gratitude to parents and later denies parent-child substitution; I infer that the focus's self-benefit is relationally generated but finally nontransferable. Alternatively, 31:33 may concern judgment generally without specifying gratitude's yield.
structural_cues: 31:33 mirrors parent and child under two negated substitution clauses, recalling the parent-directed gratitude of 31:14.

activation_trace.role: Accurate knowledge supplies the wisdom sense whose scope the ending limits.
Direct knowing, under repeated negation, supplies the limit on future mastery.
The split root's path and wind alignment supplies an exploratory model of orientation without prediction.
Each thing's own self identifies the bounded knower who cannot possess the future.
Seeking and obtaining benefit supplies the unknown future outcome at issue.
The next day supplies the immediate but inaccessible horizon.
Loss of life supplies the terminal unknown that wisdom does not forecast.

changed_reading.after: Wisdom gives orientation and gratitude gives a right response under uncertainty; neither makes the self owner of tomorrow.
changed_reading.before: Possessing wisdom and benefiting oneself suggest foresight or control of outcomes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing negations deny each self knowledge of tomorrow's gain and place of death. Wisdom and gratitude therefore benefit the self without granting predictive possession: they orient response within uncertainty, while the non-dominant path-alignment branch preserves an exploratory distinction between direction and forecast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded future knowledge, gain, tomorrow, and death; I infer that this constrains what bestowed wisdom does for the self. Alternatively, the ending may state divine omniscience without revising the practical meaning of wisdom or gratitude.
structural_cues: 31:34 repeats the negation that no self knows across tomorrow's earning and the place of death.

remaining_uncertainties: The hydraulic, botanical, breath, tribute, and foreign-arrival branches are analogical activations, not lexical substitutions.
The maritime sequence may describe types of observers rather than one person's continuous pre-danger and post-rescue trajectory.
The non-dominant cutting and path-alignment mappings sharpen mechanisms but remain form-distant exploratory overlays.
The final accountability and omniscience passages may constrain wisdom and gratitude only indirectly rather than serving as local explanations of 31:12.
strongest_changes: Wisdom moved from stored knowledge to restraint, embodied calibration, and orientation under uncertainty.
Gratitude moved from repayment to recipient-side realization of gift, with ecological growth making that realization materially vivid.
Parental dependence made gratitude relational, while the final parent-child non-substitution made its yield nontransferable.
Repeated independence and unexhausted words made bestowed wisdom participation in a non-depleting source rather than finite transfer.
The ship and rescue sequence made gratitude durable fidelity across changing conditions and ingratitude a possible re-covering of known favor.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's reflexive clause did not collapse into self-interest: it supported coexisting models of amplification, disciplined embodiment, relational formation, secure attachment, non-rival reception, and nondelegable consequence. Bridle, watercourse, anti-tribute, breath, foreign-arrival, and split-root path/cutting activations preserve the packet's stranger latent possibilities with explicit containment.

activation_trace.role: Breath exiting the interior supplies a bodily image of restored internal circulation.
Relieving constriction supplies the self-benefit as newly opened room under pressure.
Acknowledging favor supplies the response that releases rather than stores constriction.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, gratitude also lets the self breathe by opening interior room around received good.
changed_reading.before: Gratitude's benefit to the self is only moral credit or cognition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the syntax most naturally uses self, not literal breath. It remains anchored in the focus root's breath and relief branches and in gratitude's reflexive benefit; render it only as a somatic overlay, not as a lexical replacement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The benefit of gratitude is explicitly returned to the person's own nafs.

activation_trace.role: Giving establishes the actual direction of provision from giver to recipient.
A tribute paid back to authority supplies the rejected reverse-direction economic model.
Recognition of favor supplies response without turning it into a tax.
Independence from need makes a compensatory levy incoherent.

changed_reading.after: Gratitude is explicitly anti-tribute: it acknowledges the gift while all realized return remains with the recipient.
changed_reading.before: Gratitude is a due paid back to the authority who bestowed wisdom.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the tribute branch reverses the ordinary direction of the focus verb. It remains anchored in the same giving root and the explicit divine independence; render it as an economic counter-image showing what gratitude is not, never as the lexical meaning of the verb here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: God gives wisdom, gratitude returns only to the grateful self, and God is without need.

activation_trace.role: A flood arriving from another land supplies wisdom as surplus entering from beyond the recipient's native resources.
A stranger entering another people supplies the gift's initially non-native status.
A slight incoming provision showing visible effect supplies the assimilation process.
The recipient's own self supplies the site where the external arrival becomes personally effective.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, wisdom arrives as an external and initially strange influx that gratitude makes effective within the recipient's own self.
changed_reading.before: Wisdom is simply an internal faculty Luqman possesses.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because flood and stranger images do not name wisdom in the focus syntax. It remains anchored in the bestowal root and becomes coherent with gratitude's small-input effect and the self clause; render it as an arrival metaphor qualified by perhaps or as if.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Wisdom comes to Luqman through an act of bestowal and becomes beneficial within his own self through gratitude.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Wisdom delivered as corrective restraint whose first act is recognition.** **ء ت ي B002** gives granting; **ح ك م B001/B003** gives turning back to set right and rightly guided knowledge; **ش ك ر B001** is recognizing favor and praising its giver. The content clause immediately specifies gratitude after the gift of wisdom. I infer that recognition is the restraint that prevents gifted knowledge from becoming self-attribution. Wisdom thus reads as a self-correcting reception practice, not bare intellectual possession.
2. **A small reception that becomes visible in the self.** **ش ك ر B002** means being sustained by little and showing its effect; **ن ف س B011–B013** gives the living self and inner intent. Triple repetition of *sh-k-r* funnels the action back to *nafsihi*. I infer that gratitude makes received provision productive within the receiver. “He gives thanks for himself” can therefore mean that the favor’s effect grows visible in his own formed self, alongside the ordinary beneficiary reading.
3. **Covering favor cannot diminish the self-sufficient praised source.** **ك ف ر B004** is covering over a favor; **غ ن ي B001–B002** is self-sufficiency and sufficing; **ح م د B003** is one praiseworthy through many good traits. The antithesis places concealment on the human side and sufficiency on the divine side. I infer a one-way dependency: denial blocks the receiver’s recognition but removes nothing from the giver. The closing names the failed transfer’s consequence without making praise dependent on the recipient.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 31:26 repeated *al-Ghanī al-Ḥamīd* after asserting comprehensive belonging, exposing the ontological basis of the earlier gratitude asymmetry. Ayah 31:31’s *shakūr* under sea exposure then showed gratitude as the capacity to register enabling favor under strain.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Wisdom expressed as grateful restraint and right placement.** Lexical evidence: `ح ك م B003` is knowledge that reaches truth, `ح ك م B001` is restraint that sets right, and `ش ك ر B001` is recognizing a favor and displaying that recognition in praise and action. Structural cue: the content attached to granted wisdom is the imperative `أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ`; 31:13-17 then unfold warnings, limits, and commands. Assigned role: gratitude is wisdom's first enacted judgment about source and benefit. Abductive move (inferred): correctly recognizing the source of favor restrains the self from misallocating allegiance. Reading change: wisdom reads as an ethical capacity operationalized by gratitude, not merely information deposited in Luqman's mind.

2. **Gratitude as self-nourishing amplification.** Lexical evidence: `ش ك ر B002` is thriving visibly on little provision, `ش ك ر B003` is fullness and abundant milk, and `غ ن ي B001` is self-sufficiency without need. Structural cue: the root is repeated three times and its benefit is reflexively restricted by `فَإِنَّمَا ... لِنَفْسِهِ`; 31:14 adds maternal bearing and weaning, and 31:16 adds the tiny mustard seed. Assigned role: gratitude metabolizes received provision into growth in the grateful self, while divine self-sufficiency blocks any reading of repayment. Abductive move (inferred): the nourishment images explain the explicitly reflexive benefit. Reading change: gratitude becomes a mode by which the recipient flourishes, not compensation needed by the giver.

3. **Ingratitude as covering a favor whose source remains praiseworthy.** Lexical evidence: `ك ف ر B004` is covering over or failing to acknowledge a favor, and `ح م د B001` is praise and thanksgiving for praiseworthy action. Structural cue: gratitude and kufr form a conditional antithesis, but only the human consequence changes; God remains `غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ`. Assigned role: kufr occludes recognition without altering the benefactor's sufficiency or praiseworthiness. Abductive move (inferred): denial changes the receiver's relation to the favor, not the favor's source. Reading change: the closing attributes prevent ingratitude from being imagined as damage inflicted on God.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - 31:14's maternal nourishment and weaning activated the fullness/milk branch of `ش ك ر`; 31:16's tiny seed activated the little-provision-to-visible-effect branch. 31:17 then displayed wisdom's restraint as a sequence of maintained practice, public discernment, and patience.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction inside an emphatic opening formula
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the Luqman unit as a resumptive launch, not as an isolated beginning. Joined to the following emphasis particles, it moves from the prior challenge scene into a certified report of divine bestowal, with a clipped particle onset before the longer giving verb.

topics.headline: resumptive launch into certified report
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah changes scene while still carrying forward the prior argument into a certain divine report.
topics.reason: The opening conjunction is licensed as a resumptive boundary and forms one launch unit with the following emphatic particles.

topics.headline: boundary from challenge to wisdom
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and tracks the move from polemical challenge to narrative attestation of wisdom.
topics.reason: The boundary rows coherently describe the shift from the previous challenge into the Luqman narrative without changing the local parse.

words.gloss_range: oath or emphasis prefix bound into the certainty formula
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) is the emphatic prefix in the opening formula, not the preposition used later in the ayah. Its force binds the resumptive opening to the certification particle, so the bestowal of wisdom arrives as sworn certainty rather than a loose report.

topics.headline: emphatic prefix binds the launch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening is a single certainty formula before the verb, not a chain of ordinary particles.
topics.reason: QAC identifies this as the emphatic prefix in the formula, and the following particle plus perfect verb confirm the scope.

topics.headline: visible lam, non-prepositional force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes this emphatic lam from the later directional and benefactive lam forms.
topics.reason: The letter shape matches later lam forms, but local syntax before the certification particle selects emphasis rather than prepositional government.

words.gloss_range: certification particle before a perfect verb
words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) certifies the perfect verb that follows. It frames the giving of wisdom as a completed, verified act, so the command and conditionals unfold from an established gift rather than from a possibility. Across the boundary, the same divine referent from the prior challenge now emerges as the first-person giver.

topics.headline: completed gift certified
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wisdom lesson rests on a completed divine act before any human response is discussed.
topics.reason: The particle appears before a perfect verb, selecting realization and certainty rather than possibility.

topics.headline: same divine speaker emerges
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the God of the prior challenge with the first-person giver in this ayah.
topics.reason: The boundary and referent evidence support continuity from the prior divine referent into the first-person bestowal clause.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect divine bestowal with two direct objects
words.prose: {{ar:ءَاتَيْنَا}} ({{tr:ʾātaynā}}) makes the divine speaker the giver through the plural perfect ending while keeping Luqman and wisdom in the object slots. The Form IV use of {{ar:أ ت ي}} ({{tr:ʾ-t-y}}) lets the gift feel like caused arrival: wisdom is made to reach its recipient. The verb also resets the discourse from challenge to first-person divine testimony and belongs to the wider pattern of giving wisdom (2:269; 4:54; 38:20).
words.root_gloss_range: coming, bringing, and caused arrival; local Form IV selects directed bestowal

topics.headline: divine giver, recipient, and gift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the event roles packed into one verb frame: God gives, Luqman receives, and wisdom is transferred.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies two direct objects governed by the perfect first-person plural verb.

topics.headline: bestowal as caused arrival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses the gift as intentionally made to reach Luqman, while local Form IV grammar keeps the selected sense as bestowal.
topics.reason: The root field supports coming and bringing, but the local Form IV perfect with two objects selects caused transfer rather than simple motion.

topics.headline: wisdom formula resets the scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a Quranic wisdom-giving formula answers the prior challenge with positive divine action.
topics.reason: The collocation and boundary rows support a bestowal formula that marks a move from polemic into divine attestation.

words.gloss_range: proper name in accusative recipient position
words.prose: {{ar:لُقْمَٰنَ}} ({{tr:luqmāna}}) is the named first object of the giving verb, so he is the recipient rather than the source of wisdom. The rare {{ar:ل ق م}} ({{tr:l-q-m}}) intake field gives the name a received-and-ingested texture, while the proper-name grammar keeps that as pressure rather than etymological replacement. The ayah names him without a prophetic title, and the named recipient then becomes the transmitter when the name returns in 31:13.
words.root_gloss_range: morsel-taking and intake imagery; locally retained as name pressure, not as a lexical predicate

topics.headline: named recipient before universal rule
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from one identified wisdom recipient to the later whoever clauses.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence place the proper name as the first accusative object of the giving verb.

topics.headline: rare name with intake pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses a fitting intake image around the wisdom recipient without reducing the proper name to a lexical definition.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports morsel-intake imagery, while the surface remains a proper noun in recipient position.

topics.headline: recipient becomes transmitter
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that wisdom received here is not static possession; it prepares the instruction scene in 31:13.
topics.reason: The name recurs immediately in 31:13, and the local role moves from recipient to speaker without requiring a prophetic title.

words.gloss_range: definite abstract wisdom as transferred content, immediately unpacked by gratitude
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحِكْمَةَ}} ({{tr:al-ḥikmata}}) is the second object, the content made to reach Luqman. Its definiteness presents wisdom as a known category, and the {{ar:ح ك م}} ({{tr:ḥ-k-m}}) field makes it disciplined discernment rather than loose cleverness. The following explanatory particle immediately compresses this wisdom into the command to be grateful, so the abstract gift becomes directed practice. That makes Luqman's gift part of a wisdom-giving field (2:269), not an isolated honorific.
words.root_gloss_range: judging, governing, firming, and restraining; locally selected as disciplined practical discernment

topics.headline: known wisdom as transferred content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that wisdom is a definite bestowed content, not an undefined quality Luqman already owns.
topics.reason: The noun is definite and accusative as the second object in the double-object bestowal frame.

topics.headline: wisdom as disciplined discernment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands wisdom here as governed discernment that restrains and orders action, while the local command selects gratitude as its first expression.
topics.reason: The root range supports judgment, governance, and restraint, but the immediate content clause narrows the operative sense toward practical gratitude.

topics.headline: bestowed wisdom enters a larger thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Luqman's wisdom as part of a divine bestowal field and a same-surah wisdom vocabulary, not as an isolated honorific.
topics.reason: The contextual rows connect this noun to giving-wisdom patterns and same-surah uses of the wisdom root.

words.gloss_range: explanatory or infinitival hinge from wisdom to command
words.prose: {{ar:أَنِ}} ({{tr:ʾani}}) is the hinge that prevents wisdom from remaining abstract. It can be heard as explanatory and as infinitival content: wisdom is explained by gratitude, and gratitude becomes the content of the gift. The reported vowel variant marks the hinge audibly while leaving the clause relation intact.

topics.headline: wisdom unpacked as command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah defines the given wisdom by immediately turning it into a command.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the following command clause as the content complement that explicates wisdom.

topics.headline: stable relation with audible variation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that explanatory and infinitival readings both serve the same wisdom-to-gratitude link, while recitational variation affects sound rather than syntax.
topics.reason: The variant changes liaison sound, but the local complement relation remains stable.

words.gloss_range: Form I imperative of gratitude, directed personally to the addressee
words.prose: {{ar:ٱشْكُرْ}} ({{tr:ushkur}}) converts wisdom into a direct second-person obligation. The Form I imperative asks for the addressee's own gratitude, while the {{ar:ش ك ر}} ({{tr:sh-k-r}}) yield image makes gratitude a productive acknowledgment of benefit. This first occurrence becomes the seed of the ayah's triple root progression: command, conditional action, and factual self-return.
words.root_gloss_range: acknowledging benefit and productive return; locally selected as commanded gratitude

topics.headline: wisdom becomes direct command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that wisdom is not left as a quality; it is voiced as an obligation to give thanks.
topics.reason: The imperative is the content of the explanatory clause following the wisdom noun.

topics.headline: gratitude as productive acknowledgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears gratitude as an active acknowledgment that yields back, while the local form remains a simple command to the recipient.
topics.reason: The root imagery and antonym field are coherent, but Form I imperative prevents a causative or exhaustive root-branch reading.

topics.headline: root begins command-condition-fact chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows one gratitude command as it becomes the ayah's conditional engine and self-benefit result.
topics.reason: The same root recurs in three forms inside the ayah, producing a local grammatical progression.

words.gloss_range: prepositional lam directing gratitude to God
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) gives the gratitude command its target. It binds to the divine name so the act is not vague appreciation, and it prepares the later mirror where the same particle marks the self as beneficiary rather than target.

topics.headline: gratitude given a target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that gratitude is grammatically directed to God instead of remaining an internal feeling.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the preposition as governing the following divine name as the complement of the gratitude command.

topics.headline: first lam prepares the return mirror
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the ayah's circulation: gratitude goes to God, while its benefit returns to the self.
topics.reason: The repeated prepositional form appears in two different semantic roles in the ayah.

words.gloss_range: genitive divine name as the directed target of gratitude
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}) is governed by the preceding lam and names the target of gratitude. The proper divine name blocks a generic deity reading and fixes the ultimate addressee. Its later repetition in a changed case moves the ayah from gratitude directed to God to divine self-sufficiency asserted about God.
words.root_gloss_range: unique divine name with worship and disputed bewilderment derivation pressure; locally selected as the one to whom gratitude is directed

topics.headline: God as gratitude target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that wisdom's gratitude is aimed at God, not at a vague source or intermediary.
topics.reason: The divine name is genitive under the preceding preposition and functions as the complement of the gratitude command.

topics.headline: unique divine name, not generic deity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps worship and reverent bewilderment pressure in view while the local phrase selects the unique divine name as addressee.
topics.reason: The derivational field can color the name, but the local proper noun form selects the unique divine referent.

topics.headline: name shifts from target to subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the divine name from target of gratitude to subject of self-sufficiency and praise.
topics.reason: The same divine name recurs later with different case and syntactic role, supporting the argument's shift.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction moving from command to universal maxim
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) marks the turn from direct command to universal principle. It separates the imperative from the whoever construction and starts the cadence that will be repeated for the opposite branch.

topics.headline: command opens into maxim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command to Luqman immediately becomes a general rule for anyone.
topics.reason: The conjunction before the conditional particle introduces a new universal conditional clause rather than another direct command.

topics.headline: first refrain of paired conditionals
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first half of a paired conditional pattern before the negative branch repeats it.
topics.reason: The same conjunction-plus-conditional pattern recurs at the second branch.

words.gloss_range: universal conditional pronoun governing the gratitude branch
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) universalizes the gratitude command. The named recipient gives way to whoever performs gratitude, and the pronoun supplies the generic subject of the following jussive verb. This is the first half of the ayah's paired moral alternatives, moving the verse from gift to command to binary maxim.

topics.headline: whoever opens the gratitude branch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Luqman's command is generalized to any human responder.
topics.reason: The conditional pronoun governs the following jussive verb and supplies its generic subject.

topics.headline: first half of the binary frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah moving from gift and command into a balanced pair of human alternatives.
topics.reason: The conditional pronoun recurs later with the opposite verb, making formal parity between the two branches.

words.gloss_range: jussive imperfect gratitude in the conditional protasis
words.prose: {{ar:يَشْكُرْ}} ({{tr:yashkur}}) is the hypothetical gratitude of the whoever clause. Its jussive ending marks dependency on the condition, while its root identity carries forward the command. The same act that was commanded now becomes universally testable before it reappears as factual self-return.
words.root_gloss_range: acknowledging benefit and productive return; locally the hypothetical positive action

topics.headline: gratitude as condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the small mood change that turns commanded gratitude into a conditional human act.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as imperfect jussive governed by the preceding conditional pronoun.

topics.headline: middle step in the gratitude ladder
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows one root from direct command into condition and then into realized consequence.
topics.reason: The repeated root appears with distinct mood values across the command, protasis, and apodosis.

topics.headline: productive return set up
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the gratitude action already leaning toward its self-benefit result, while the actual beneficiary is stated only in the following clause.
topics.reason: The productive root image and self-return collocation are coherent, but the local word itself remains the conditional action before the benefit phrase.

words.gloss_range: consequential particle introducing the first apodosis
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) turns the gratitude condition into its answer. Bound to the restriction particle that follows, it makes the self-benefit clause the direct consequence of gratitude, and it sets up the repeated answer marker in the kufr branch.

topics.headline: gratitude receives its consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that self-benefit is not a side comment; it is the formal answer to the gratitude condition.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the apodosis of the preceding conditional clause.

topics.headline: answer marker will recur
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the two conditional branches held in formal parallel even though their outcomes differ.
topics.reason: The same answer particle introduces both apodoses, with different following particles.

words.gloss_range: restriction operator limiting gratitude's benefit to the self
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّمَا}} ({{tr:innamā}}) restricts the benefit of gratitude: it returns only to the grateful self. Its added particle also distinguishes this branch from the later bare emphatic particle, so the two apodoses are formally parallel but theologically asymmetrical: human gain is restricted, divine independence is asserted.

topics.headline: benefit restricted to self
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that gratitude benefits the grateful person alone and does not add anything to God.
topics.reason: The fused particle functions as a restriction operator over the following self-benefit predicate.

topics.headline: restriction versus assertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the two branches match in frame but differ in force: the first restricts human benefit, the second asserts divine attributes.
topics.reason: The first apodosis uses a restriction construction, while the second uses the bare emphatic particle with governance.

words.gloss_range: indicative imperfect gratitude in the restricted apodosis
words.prose: {{ar:يَشْكُرُ}} ({{tr:yashkuru}}) repeats the gratitude verb, but now as the predicate of the restricted answer. The final vowel marks a move from jussive condition to indicative fact: whoever gives thanks is, in reality, giving thanks for his own self.
words.root_gloss_range: acknowledging benefit and productive return; locally the realized self-benefiting predicate

topics.headline: condition becomes factual return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a tiny mood shift turns hypothetical gratitude into stated consequence.
topics.reason: The verb is indicative in the apodosis after the restriction particle, unlike the jussive protasis form.

topics.headline: same actor receives the benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the actor of gratitude remains continuous and that the action returns to that actor's self.
topics.reason: The subject remains the earlier conditional actor, and the following benefactive phrase routes the result back to that self.

topics.headline: third gratitude form completes chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the command-condition-fact chain complete in the third gratitude form.
topics.reason: The ayah has three same-root gratitude forms with different grammatical roles.

words.gloss_range: benefactive lam marking the self as beneficiary
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) repeats the earlier particle but changes its work. The first lam directed gratitude to God; this second lam marks the self as the site of benefit, completing the outward-to-inward circulation of gratitude.

topics.headline: benefit routed to self
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same particle now marks where gratitude returns rather than where gratitude is directed.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the possessed self noun as the benefactive complement in the apodosis.

topics.headline: benefit with accountability pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps self-accountability in view, while the local restriction selects self-benefit as the primary force.
topics.reason: The preposition can mark benefit or disadvantage, but the restrictive gratitude clause favors benefit in this local branch.

words.gloss_range: possessed singular self as the beneficiary of gratitude
words.prose: {{ar:نَفْسِهِۦ}} ({{tr:nafsihi}}) closes the first conditional branch by naming the grateful actor's own self as beneficiary. The suffix sends the result back to the same whoever, and the singular possessed form individualizes the return. The {{ar:ن ف س}} ({{tr:n-f-s}}) field lets the benefit feel inward and living, not merely external credit.
words.root_gloss_range: self, soul, person, breath, and inward life; locally the actor's own self as beneficiary

topics.headline: own self receives the return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that gratitude's benefit is reflexive: the doer receives the return in his own self.
topics.reason: The possessed noun is genitive under the benefactive preposition, and the suffix refers back to the conditional actor.

topics.headline: self, soul, and breath pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses the self-benefit as inward and moral, while local syntax keeps the reference to the grateful person's own self.
topics.reason: The root field supports self, soul, and breath associations, but the local phrase selects the beneficiary of the gratitude act.

topics.headline: branch sealed before contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the positive branch close as a self-return pattern before the ingratitude branch begins.
topics.reason: The contextual rows support a Quranic self-return pattern, and the noun sits at the end of the first branch.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction introducing the paired negative conditional
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the second conditional with the first. It repeats the frame but swaps the verb, so the same universal human field is now tested by the opposite response.

topics.headline: second branch coordinated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ingratitude is presented as the paired alternative to gratitude, not as a disconnected topic.
topics.reason: The conjunction introduces a second conditional parallel to the first one.

topics.headline: echo pairs the two outcomes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the repeated frame that makes the contrast controlled and balanced.
topics.reason: The repeated conjunction-plus-conditional structure links the branches as alternatives.

words.gloss_range: second universal conditional pronoun opening the kufr branch
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) repeats the same whoever frame for the negative branch. The subject class does not change; only the predicate changes. That formal identity makes the moral contrast fall on gratitude versus ingratitude, not on different kinds of people.

topics.headline: same whoever, opposite action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ingratitude branch applies to the same universal human field as the gratitude branch.
topics.reason: The conditional pronoun supplies the subject of the following perfect verb and matches the earlier conditional frame.

topics.headline: binary contrast anchored by repeated pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the two branches aligned so that the verbs carry the moral opposition.
topics.reason: The repeated pronoun keeps the agents formally identical while the predicates oppose each other.

words.gloss_range: perfect Form I ingratitude or covering-over in contrast to gratitude
words.prose: {{ar:كَفَرَ}} ({{tr:kafara}}) names the opposite response to gratitude. Its perfect aspect makes the covering-over act feel decisive, and the {{ar:ك ف ر}} ({{tr:k-f-r}}) field selects ingratitude in this gratitude context rather than a generic label alone. The verb triggers a different kind of answer: not self-return, but an emphatic assertion that God remains self-sufficient and praiseworthy.
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealing, denying, and ingratitude; locally selected as covering over received benefit

topics.headline: ingratitude as covering over benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the negative branch as a decisive act of covering received benefit, while the local contrast with gratitude selects ingratitude as the main sense.
topics.reason: The root range supports covering and denial, and the immediate opposition to gratitude narrows the local sense to ingratitude.

topics.headline: acknowledgment versus concealment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah's moral binary as acknowledgment of benefit versus concealment of benefit.
topics.reason: The local ayah explicitly contrasts the gratitude root with the ingratitude root, and 14:7 provides a direct gratitude-ingratitude pairing.

topics.headline: opposite action gets attribute answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ingratitude does not produce harm to God; it elicits an attribute clause declaring divine independence.
topics.reason: The following apodosis differs from the gratitude branch and same-surah echoes at 31:23 and 31:32 preserve the ingratitude thread.

words.gloss_range: consequential particle introducing the second apodosis
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) gives the ingratitude branch its answer. It moves directly from human denial into a divine attribute assertion, so the branch does not narrate damage to God; it states God's independent status.

topics.headline: ingratitude receives its answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine self-sufficiency is the formal answer to ingratitude.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the apodosis of the second conditional clause.

topics.headline: parallel answer, divergent assertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the two branches kept parallel by the answer marker while their following particles create different effects.
topics.reason: The answer marker recurs, but here it is bound to the emphatic particle rather than the restriction construction.

words.gloss_range: emphatic governing particle introducing the final divine attribute clause
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) turns the negative branch into an emphatic nominal clause. Unlike the earlier restriction particle, this bare form governs the divine name and asserts the attribute pair. The result is a maxim-like closure: ingratitude is answered by what God is, not by what the ingrate can do to God.

topics.headline: emphasis governs the closing clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the answer to ingratitude is a strengthened divine attribute assertion.
topics.reason: The particle governs the following divine name and strengthens the nominal predicate pair.

topics.headline: bare emphasis contrasts restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the first branch restricts human benefit, while the second branch asserts divine reality.
topics.reason: The absence of the restrictive added particle leaves ordinary governance and emphasis active.

topics.headline: specific denial answered by general truth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing clause exceeds the case of one ingrate and states a general divine truth.
